action: Cobre clients: follow the company's direct communications and use only its official channels for updates; no vendor fix or indicators have been published.
date_note: Cobre says the incident occurred in the early hours of Thursday 19 November 2026 (Portafolio, published 19 Nov).
exec: A Latin American B2B payments provider reports an incident under containment; clients should watch its notices.
geo_basis: country as stated (Colombian fintech); no city given in the source
plain: Cobre, a Colombian company that handles payments between businesses, says it had a cybersecurity incident on 19 November and is containing it. It says client funds and client data were not affected.

sources.name: Cobre status page: Temporary API and Portal unavailability due to internal validations

summary: Cobre, a Colombian business-payments fintech, confirmed a cybersecurity incident that it says occurred early on 19 November 2026 and said it is working on containment. It says client funds remain intact and client data and credentials were not affected or accessed. Its status page listed the API and Portal as unavailable for "internal platform validations" from 19 November and operating normally on 21 November; that notice does not mention a security incident.
title: Cobre, Colombian payments fintech, confirms cybersecurity incident and says it is containing it

validation.note: One publisher, Portafolio (19 Nov), relaying Cobre's statement on the incident. Cobre's own status page (read 23 Nov) shows API and Portal unavailable for internal validations 19-21 Nov but does not name a security incident, so the incident itself remains single-source.

review.note: Compared title, 19 Nov date, funds intact and no client data or credentials affected, containment, unspecified origin and scope against Portafolio (single source, correctly marked)
